fusions.name: Spun to the Rim
fusions.desc: Releases a ring of poison around you that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each one [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target then spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Drawn Clean Out
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A strike that deals 18 damage, consumes every affliction you have on the target and adds 1.2 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Circulation Flush
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Run Its Course
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.
